name: Question 7
problem:
Consider the following congruence.

$$
-5≡\bbox[2pt,lightgray]{\phantom{A}}\,(\text{mod}\,11)
$$

Which of the following values gives a true statement when inserted into the blank space?

I. $-16$

II. $7$

III. $17$

Question 7
?

Consider the following congruence.

−5≡A(mod11) Which of the following values gives a true statement when inserted into the blank space?

  1. −16
  2. 7
  3. 17

−16 only
b
−16,7, and 17
c
−16 and 7 only
d
−16 and 17 only
e
7 and 17 only
